import { createAgent, defineEval } from 'lousho';
import config from './agent.js';

defineEval({
  name: 'word count',
  agent: () => createAgent(config),
  async test(t) {
    await t.send('How many words are in "the quick brown fox"?');
    t.calledTool('word_count', { args: { text: 'the quick brown fox' } });
  },
});
